notes.title: Isabelle gets major artistic cosmetic surgery!!!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35270404/b6269ea2460926403284877b5cafb72e1aa91b89.gif
Isabelle Fine released with a very simple, let's say, an over-simplified art style. Although it was charming in a way, it just wasn't getting the job done, so it's time to give old Izzy a facelift.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35270404/3f8cbea06e2f6503f6b26c1324efad44e640ff6d.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35270404/065bf02297a1605f10e0742d529967f0fb12a790.pnghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35270404/14c2dcf515815645464196402f0727705faa9ebf.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35270404/d6351c31f922a8ae1b9ab743c2099f3f70c9debb.png
We've revved the art on almost every aspect of the game to create a look that's much more appealing and much cleaner and easy to read. It's still designer art, but it's like stage 3 advanced designer art. :) Even with these pretty major changes, Izzy's personality shines right on through.

I'd love for you to try it out and I look forward to your feedback. Thanks to everyone for the support, we look forward to further fine tuning on Isabelle and development of her next adventure.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1024100
